_note: Hand-written, rule-based mapping from screening results to the type of doctor to consult. It is general care-navigation guidance for an educational prototype, NOT clinically validated, and never replaces a clinician's referral. A general physician is always the first-line option except in emergencies.

specialties.name: Emergency department
specialties.what: Immediate care for serious or life-threatening symptoms.

specialties.name: General medicine
specialties.what: First point of contact for most health concerns; can examine you, order tests and refer you to a specialist.

specialties.name: Endocrinology
specialties.what: Hormone and metabolic conditions such as diabetes and thyroid disorders.

specialties.name: Cardiology
specialties.what: Heart and blood-vessel conditions, including high blood pressure and cholesterol-related risk.

specialties.name: Pulmonology
specialties.what: Lung and breathing conditions such as asthma, pneumonia and tuberculosis.

specialties.name: Haematology
specialties.what: Blood conditions such as persistent anaemia or abnormal blood counts.

specialties.name: Urology
specialties.what: Urinary tract and bladder conditions, including recurrent infections.

specialties.name: Neurology
specialties.what: Brain and nerve conditions, including frequent or unusual headaches.

specialties.name: Mental health
specialties.what: Mood, anxiety and other mental-health concerns.

common_cold.when: if symptoms last more than 10 days or get worse

dengue.when: go to a hospital at once if warning signs appear

gastroenteritis.when: if symptoms persist beyond two weeks

type_2_diabetes.when: if blood sugar stays high or is hard to control

hypertension.when: if blood pressure stays high or heart symptoms appear

iron_deficiency_anaemia.when: if anaemia persists or the cause is unclear

hyperlipidaemia.when: if cholesterol stays high or you have other heart risk factors

asthma.when: if symptoms are frequent or not controlled

pneumonia.when: if not improving or breathing gets worse

tuberculosis.when: TB testing and free treatment are also available at government TB / DOTS centres

migraine.when: if headaches are frequent, severe or unusual for you

vitamin_b12_deficiency.when: if levels stay low or there are nerve symptoms

depression.when: talking to a professional helps; you do not need a referral to start
